hmac.nonce: lowercase UUIDv4; one use, including receipt reads
hmac.pathMapping: The Edge gateway strips /functions/v1. The handler accepts only edgePath and signs the corresponding fixed externalPath; activation must verify this on the deployed gateway.

heartbeat.observed_at: UTC ISO 8601 with milliseconds and Z; within clock skew
heartbeat.checkpointFields: All three null, or UUIDv4 plus canonical UTC timestamps. Accepted receipt capture time must match; checked_at >= captured_at and <= server now. Backup-required health also requires checked_at age <= 900 seconds.

checkpoint.format: Raw age v1 ciphertext, never plaintext, armor, multipart or base64; server checks the age v1 prefix but has no decryption key.
checkpoint.captureTime: Immutable canonical UTC timestamp from the original queue checkpoint; independent of latest live queue validation time.
checkpoint.lostAcknowledgement: Persist UUID, exact ciphertext, digest and immutable capture time before sending. GET receipt with a fresh nonce; only missing permits POST. Never re-encrypt, overwrite, resend a pending write, or reuse a retired UUID.

receipt.missing: All three metadata fields are null.
receipt.pending: An unexpired-by-design upload reservation. The server may accept it only after bounded download and exact byte/hash verification. Absence does not prove an in-flight write failed.
receipt.tombstones: UUID identities and ciphertext metadata are permanent private receipts, including retired objects; no member payload.

retention.dailyRule: Latest captured snapshot for each of today and the preceding six UTC+8 calendar days; union with latest eight snapshots.

storage.cleanup: Serialized durable claim, exact receipt-owned key and bounded ciphertext hash verification, Storage API remove, absence verification, permanent retired receipt. Pre-admission may retire an eligible obsolete object to make room before the sixteenth reservation.
storage.incidentHold: Unknown objects, mismatching ciphertext or unresolved deletion stop automation. Pending/deleting/blocked fences never expire or auto-clear. Provider uncertainty requires separately approved reconciliation.

activation: Separate exact approval after source publication, additive migration, deployed route/auth/Storage verification, hosted cron and fresh recovery drill. Local workstation is never a production runtime dependency.
